newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal leaves key rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal leaves key rates unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal left its key absorption rate, used to drain funds from the money market, and emergency lending rate unchanged at 6.2 and 8.3 percent respectively.
It also offered to inject 10 billion escudos of seven-day funds into the money market in a variable rate securities repurchase pact. Bids must be submitted by 1515 GMT.
The Bank of Portugal previously injected funds at 6.50 percent.
